snippet.title: Stirge Hunters Playtesting! Combat, Level Progression, Stirge Nests
snippet.description: This is a playtest of Stirge Hunters demonstrating stirge combat, stirge nests, and level progression together for the first time! Combat releases on Feb. 25th!
